newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Norilsk proposes 30,000 rouble share price.
newsitem.headline: Norilsk proposes 30,000 rouble share price.

text.p: Russia's RAO Norilsky Nikel metals and mining group has proposed issuing around 126 million ordinary shares to existing shareholders only and at a price of 30,000 roubles per share, a group spokesman said on Tuesday.

Anatoly Komrakov said the 30,000-rouble price tag was one of a package of proposals due to be put before shareholders at an extraordinary meeting set for September 8. The shares have a nominal price of 250 roubles, while the current market price of Norilsk shares is around $14.00, or over 81,000 roubles.
"There is a concrete proposal to set the price at 30,000 roubles," Komrakov said. "The shareholders will vote on this at the meeting (on September 8)."
Asked what impact setting the price at way below market value would have on share prices overall, Komrakov said he could not comment on how the market has reacted or may react to the proposals.

Norilsk ordinary shares fell sharply on the Russian Trading System in reaction to news that Norilsk was planning to double its charter capital through the ordinary share issue. But the market had closed before the proposed price of the new shares was announced.
At the close shares were last trading at $14.00 from Monday's close of $17.00.
